notes: Schematic and layout are different coordinate spaces; matching requires anchors + iterative refinement.
Start by mapping obvious external pads from signals.txt (e.g. *_PAD, CLK1/CLK2, SYNC, CMROM/CMRAM*).
Use `docs/evidence/schematic_layout_match_v0/<chip>_schematic_layout_match_v0.md` to see both: (1) degree/area candidates and (2) periphery pad-like candidates.
Use the rendered overlays/crops under `docs/evidence/layout_pad_candidates_v0/<chip>/` to visually inspect candidate nodes on the metal mask.
Then fill `layout_node` for each anchor and re-run `python3 scripts/match_schematic_layout_v0.py --chip <chip>`.
